name: BADM 3403
title: UX / UI Design
description: (Also offered as OPIM 3403.) This course is designed to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of user experience (UX) and user interface (UI) design principles, methodologies, and practices. The course will cover the structure of design thinking and guide students through the iterative design process, from initial concept development to final UI implementation.
requirement_description: Open only to non-business majors of junior or higher status.
